author: bardic-inspiration
name: Hushed Sling
summary: A sling that makes no sound and slings stones with extra bite.
description: Its leather is stitched with thread that smells of wet moss. Poachers prize it and gamekeepers hate it.

stats.effect: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Attacks made with it make no sound, and a creature that fails to see you attack does not learn where you are from the sound of it.
